title: urostigma thonningii
intro: Urostigma thonningii, commonly known as African bitter leaf or Onugbu, is a plant species belonging to the family Moraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Urostigma thonningii are attributed to its ability to act as an antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, making it effective in fighting off infections and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
